versions.changelog:
kami-smarthome-suite v1.0.9

- Updated guided setup instructions for greater clarity and accuracy, especially first-time onboarding and required checks.
- Revised steps for sub-skill installation, API key prompting, and camera configuration guidance.
- Improved prompts and requirements for Feishu notification configurations, presenting both basic and advanced tiers.
- Clarified the usage and presentation of RTSP URL brand templates in setup guidance.
- Removed references to the device auto-discovery API and streamlined camera setup flow.
- Updated documentation for a more concise, user-focused onboarding process.

kami-smarthome-suite 1.0.8

- Removed redundant skill-card.md file for a cleaner repository.
- Updated SKILL.md with improved guided setup instructions and device discovery flow.
- Added requirement: on setup, automatically call the device-discovery API with the provided API key to enumerate RTSP cameras before prompting for manual input.
- Clarified that the RTSP URL template table must always be shown up-front, not after manual entry begins.
- Ensured post-install flow immediately proceeds to API key and device discovery, streamlining first-use onboarding.

kami-smarthome-suite v1.0.7

- Improved guided notification setup: now explicitly presents both Feishu Webhook and "self-built app" (inline image) tiers, with hints for App ID/Secret.
- Updated configuration wizard instructions for greater clarity and completeness.
- Minor updates to SKILL.md documentation for onboarding and configuration guidance.

Version 1.0.6 Changelog

- Updated guided setup instructions to require always rendering the full RTSP camera brand template table during setup and configuration.
- Added a step to explicitly prompt for camera configuration if the `cameras` field is empty in the config file.
- Included a new warning: maximum 2 skills per camera due to RTSP session limits on most consumer cameras.
- Refined and clarified the agent setup behavior and checklist for better user guidance.

kami-smarthome-suite v1.0.5

- Added support for Feishu self-built app notifications; now allows inline snapshot/image uploads in alarm pushes via Feishu OpenAPI.
- Updated notification channel documentation in SKILL.md to describe Feishu self-built app options and snapshot handling per platform.
- General documentation improvements and clarifications for notification workflows.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

kami-smarthome-suite 1.0.4

- Updated notification channel support: package-detection can now send push alarms (Feishu, Telegram, Discord), and supports Discord bot notifications.
- Clarified included skill descriptions and improved accuracy of package-detection's notification handling.
- Removed duplicate/inaccurate details from documentation and brought SKILL.md information in line with actual skill behavior.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.

kami-smarthome-suite 1.0.3

- Improved and clarified centralized configuration with more concise wording in documentation.
- Refined setup and configuration wizard instructions for clarity.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation adjustments in SKILL.md, including streamlined design principles and prerequisites.
- No user-facing feature or behavioral changes.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated setup.sh script.
- No user-facing feature changes; this is a minor maintenance update.

- Removed deprecated skill card file (skill-card.md).
- Updated configure.py for improved configuration management.
- Documentation in SKILL.md refreshed; minor typo/formatting corrections.
- No user-facing feature or behavior changes.

Initial release of kami-smarthome-suite

- One-click installer for the full Kami SmartHome ecosystem, bundling 6 related skills.
- Centralized configuration for API key, cameras, and notifications—no need to configure each skill separately.
- Interactive setup script guides users through installation and config, then syncs settings to all sub-skills.
- Includes skills for package detection, image/video search, fall/incident/conflict detection, and suspicious person alerts.
- Designed with a single source of truth—update config in one file and distribute to all installed components.
